newsitem.title: JAPAN: Airman missing after falling into Japan sea.
newsitem.headline: Airman missing after falling into Japan sea.

text.p: A Japanese airman was missing on Tuesday after plunging more than a thousand feet (more than 300 metres) from the back of a plane into the Sea of Japan, a defence ministry spokesman said.
Air Force Private Yoshihiro Okamoto fell from the cargo hold of a C-1 military transport plane during cargo airdrop exercises, the spokesman said.

A rescue and recovery operation was being mounted by maritime safety, navy and air forces, which sent a patrol boat, three helicopters and two aircraft to the site of Okamoto's disappearance less than a mile (kilometre) offshore northeast of the Kakujima lighthouse in western Japan's Yamaguchi Prefecture.
Okamoto, 25, was alone in the rear cargo hold of the C-1 executing mock cargo airdrops when he fell out.
The four other crew members noticed his absence when his headset interphone went silent.
The defence ministry spokesman said he could not comment on the likelihood of Okamoto being found alive.
